evidence.note: Charcoal serif title on white with soft, low-saturation blue blurred blobs; calm, no glare.
Grey, blue and dark-red arrow strokes on white cards; blue-filled check badges; red used only as stroke and a short label lead-in in the callout, on white.
Blue-outlined agent dots and grey lines on pale grey panel; single red alert dot and red lock badge as small fills.
Blue, charcoal and red dots with legend; brights limited to small fills and strokes on light grey; no bright-on-bright pairings.
White cards, charcoal text, small blue bullets and blue kicker; restrained.
Charcoal 'Thank you' on white with soft blue blobs; consistent with title slide.

rationale: The deck uses a consistent charcoal-on-white base with one blue accent and red reserved for semantic emphasis, matching the reference pass anchor. Bright colours appear as strokes, dots, badges and soft background washes, never as text on a saturated fill. No glaring or clashing combinations are visible.
